items.author: truediff.dev
items.context: 1 hour of digging through Wine crash dumps and parsing container logs on the Steam Deck just to trace down a single missing Steamworks interface (No SteamUtils011). The fix? Switching to Proton 10.0-4. That’s it. 🫪 At least it runs now. #SteamDeck #LinuxGaming #Enshrouded
items.text: An hour hunting down one missing interface, rough. Glad a Proton version swap sorted it, hope Enshrouded runs smoothly now.
